scope: The surviving Valerian Palace ruins at Bishapur, limited to the photographed ashlared walls and nearby low masonry traces inside the mapped enclosure.

quallaSearch.notes: The two exact Qualla originals show the remains in 2025. The mapped polygon identifies this ruin separately from the neighboring Anahita Temple, Mosaic Porch and ceremonial buildings.
